game: Vyruz: Destruction of the Untel Empire
approach: Functional reimplementation from reverse engineering of Vyruz.exe, C++23 with a Vulkan 1.3 renderer, loading the original vz-data.rsc
notes: The whole single-player campaign with the intro and cutscenes, playable start to finish with the original's rules. The main branch adds a network co-op campaign for up to four players, wide screens, gamepad support, modern audio and graphics; the classic branch keeps the original rules. Needs the original game data.
